# pcd_networking_subnet_ids (Data Source)

Look up the IDs of all Neutron subnets matching the given filters, sorted ascending.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_network" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-network"
}

# Look up the IDs of all subnets attached to the network.
data "pcd_networking_subnet_ids" "example" {
  network_id = pcd_networking_network.example.id
  ip_version = 4
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) Filter by CIDR.
- `gateway_ip` (String) Filter by gateway IP.
- `ip_version` (Number) Filter by IP version (4 or 6).
- `name` (String) Filter by name.
- `network_id` (String) Filter by network.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `tenant_id` (String) Filter by owning project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A stable hash of the matched subnet IDs.
- `ids` (List of String) The matched subnet IDs, sorted ascending.
